name: class101-for-webos
description: Unofficial LG webOS TV app for CLASS101: remote-friendly lectures, every login method, 0.75–2x playback with pitch-kept sound

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run check:compat && node scripts/tv.mjs package
scripts.test: node test/wsola.test.mjs && npm run build -- --dev && node test/e2e.mjs && node test/speed.mjs && node test/speed-e2e.mjs && node test/login.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run package && node scripts/tv.mjs install && node scripts/tv.mjs launch
